about: The suite (doc 97): every component of the estate declares the edition it starts in and the shared platform services it uses, so each one is built ready to be sold to organisations of any size, the way one productivity suite is sold to individuals, businesses and enterprises. ./securax suite reads it; fitness 'enterprise-declared' fails a feature that is not declared here.
open_core: Everything one person, family or single organisation needs to be safe is free to use, with its code public (FSL-1.1-MIT, each release MIT after two years): every component, identity with SSO and MFA, export, residency, backups and recovery. No SSO tax, ever.
Security fixes reach every edition at the same time.
Export of your own data always works, in every edition, in a plain format.

What is commercial is what running many people and many organisations takes: the tenant admin centre, SCIM provisioning, licensing and billing, managed hosting and a support desk with an SLA. That code lives in a separate private repository; this public repository carries only the interfaces.
A commercial service is never the only way to do something safely: there is always an open, self-hosted path.

identity.name: Identity: sign-in (SSO via OIDC), MFA, device and API keys

export.name: Export: your data in a plain file, always

residency.name: Data residency: classification-aware routing and a region allow-list

continuity.name: Continuity: encrypted backups, ransomware checks, restore drills, any machine carries the estate

updates.name: Updates: stable and beta channels, safe update, rollback

rbac.name: Roles: who may see and change what
rbac.gap: roles exist on the gateway; the sync, the kit apps and the registers are single-user

audit.name: Audit: tamper-evident log of who did what, ready for a SIEM
audit.gap: the chain covers the gateway; one estate-wide stream and a SIEM export are still to do

tenancy.name: Tenancy: one organisation's data and quota kept apart from another's
tenancy.gap: tenant cells exist on the cluster path; the laptop and VPS path is one tenant, and sync rows are per person

policy.name: Policy: switches an administrator sets (regulated mode, kill switch, allowances)
policy.gap: policies are set per machine, not per tenant

metering.name: Metering: usage per tenant and per person
metering.gap: AI use is metered; seats and storage per edition are not

api.name: API: a versioned, documented interface others can build on
api.gap: the gateway and sync APIs work but are not versioned or published as a contract

admin-centre.name: Admin centre: one console for a tenant's users, seats, policies, audit and bills
admin-centre.gap: not built; the cockpit and the switches are the open, single-tenant start

scim.name: SCIM: joiners, movers and leavers synced from the customer's identity provider
scim.gap: not built; offboarding is manual today

licensing.name: Licensing and billing: entitlements per edition, licence keys, invoices with GST

hosting.name: Managed hosting: nodes and tenant cells run for the customer in India regions
hosting.gap: the estate runs on your own machines today; operating it for others needs runbooks and monitoring

support.name: Support desk with an SLA (the open support packet is its intake)
support.gap: not built; ./securax support-packet already gathers what a desk would need

editions.name: Community
editions.who: anyone: a person, a family, a student, a small team that self-hosts

editions.name: Pro
editions.who: one professional: a CISO, a founder, a data protection officer

editions.name: Enterprise
editions.who: a regulated or large organisation, or a group of companies

add_ons.name: Concierge
add_ons.what: set-up done for them, a private node, a monthly human review, an incident hotline

add_ons.name: Range training
add_ons.what: facilitated exercises on the cyber range with a scored report

add_ons.name: Govern advisory
add_ons.what: the Govern assessment and Board pack, prepared with a person

price_reference.note: Prices are rupees per user per month, excluding 18% GST, and are hypotheses to test. For scale only, Indian resellers list one global productivity suite (October 2026, excluding GST) at about: business entry Rs 125-145, business standard Rs 660-770, business premium Rs 1,500-1,830, enterprise E3 Rs 1,900-2,700, enterprise E5 Rs 3,100-3,700. Those quotes vary by up to half between resellers; always get a partner quote.

progress.enterprise: a team view of each person's rhythm, shared only with their consent

venture.enterprise: a profit and loss per edition and per add-on

ship.enterprise: the same loop for every team's repositories, with approvals and an audit of every merge

names.enterprise: a name per tenant on the customer's own domain, with certificates issued for them

store-apps.enterprise: branded store apps per customer, published and updated for them

suite.enterprise: entitlements checked from the licence instead of declared on paper

cyber-range.enterprise: many teams and exercises at once, SSO for players, scored evidence kept for audit

respond.enterprise: case files shared with the crisis team under roles, evidence kept for regulators

adversary.enterprise: a bounty-finding ledger per business unit, with repeat-class rate and time-to-regression on the board scorecard

next.enterprise: a role-aware next step per person and team, from the same engine

inspect.enterprise: one organisation-wide list of vetted software

controls.enterprise: control owners across the organisation, with evidence per control

incident-clock.enterprise: reporting clocks for every entity in a group, in one regulator view

comply.enterprise: gap maps per entity, with evidence retention

risks.enterprise: one risk register across business units, owners signing in to update theirs

cockpit.enterprise: a cockpit per tenant and one for the group

govern.enterprise: maturity per entity, and a group Board report

vantage.enterprise: registers shared with deputies, and the Board pack built from the group's numbers

gateway.enterprise: AI allowance, policy and audit per tenant, with residency enforced

chat.enterprise: private AI chat for every employee, under the gateway's rails

accurate-answers.enterprise: answers grounded in the organisation's approved sources

build.enterprise: governed AI coding for an engineering team

backup.enterprise: encrypted backups per tenant, with restore proofs

why.enterprise: diagnoses sent straight to the support desk

continuity.enterprise: a group-wide continuity plan, with drills logged as evidence

ransomware-recovery.enterprise: restore drills per tenant, reported to the Board

guiding-map.enterprise: a wellbeing programme employees opt into; the data stays theirs

life-papers.enterprise: a family office or HR service reading members' papers on their own devices, with consent per document

scan-doc.enterprise: bulk intake of paper documents on members' own devices, with per-document consent

lens.enterprise: a shared, on-device fraud-signal model and classification policy a bank or family office can tune and push to members, the raw text never leaving their devices

readiness.enterprise: an audit firm or a group with many entities: one assessment per entity, sign-off by a second person, evidence files, and a portfolio view

passwords.enterprise: shared vaults per team; leavers removed through SCIM

online.enterprise: sign-in through the organisation's own identity provider

nodes.enterprise: a dedicated node or cell per tenant

channel.enterprise: the tenant's administrator chooses stable or beta
